Module com.mathcat.mathcat
Package com.mathcat.mathcat.controllers

Class ChatController

java.lang.Object
com.mathcat.mathcat.controllers.ChatController
public class ChatController extends Object
Controller for the AI hint chat panel. Manages the conversation history, renders chat bubbles, and communicates with AIService on a background thread.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initialises the chat controller when the FXML is loaded. Sets up the AI service, auto-scroll behaviour, and enforces a per-message character limit on the input field.

    • setQuestion

      public void setQuestion(String question)
      Sets the current math question context for the AI tutor. Should be called by the question screen before the chat is shown, so the AI knows which problem the student is working on.
      Parameters:
      question - the math question the student is attempting to solve

    • isAiUsed

      public boolean isAiUsed()
      Returns whether the student used the AI hint system for this question. If true, no bonus reward should be given.
      Returns:
      true if AI was used at least once

    • resetForNewQuestion

      public void resetForNewQuestion()
      Resets the chat session for a new question. Clears conversation history, removes all messages from the chat window, and resets the AI used flag.

    • setAnswer

      public void setAnswer(String answer)
      Sets the correct answer for the current question. Passed to the AI system prompt only - never shown directly to the student.
      Parameters:
      answer - the correct answer as a string
